sourceBrief: A real cinematic voyage begins as a folded paper boat. AutoPromote generates the raw material from an idea and uses its existing Director and render pipeline to make the film. The reveal is a full-size working boat at sea, not a paper boat surviving at sea.
prompt: One unbroken photographic camera shot, visually continuous from its first frame to its last. A handmade folded ivory paper boat on a warm workbench begins to change. Hold long enough to recognize the original folded hull. One central paper crease lifts and becomes the mast; the same connected paper sail stretches into real cream canvas. Keep the bow and hull clearly visible while the folded paper facets become curved wet mahogany planks. The camera eases back as the workbench gradually becomes deep reflective blue water around the same vessel. Water gains depth and wake only as the hull grows; spray remains light and does not cover the material change. End on a full-size working yacht sailing forward in open water, sunlight grazing wood and canvas. Natural optical depth, coherent geometry, realistic fluid motion.
